role: source atomic sentence indexed by a natural number
notes: Primitive atom; source overload with valuation set is explicitly typed in the model definition.

role: source valuation set assigned to the nth atom
notes: In membership expressions this is P(n); not a sentence. Source uses the same printed glyph in these two types.

role: source valuation mapping from natural numbers to world sets
notes: The model component; P_n is its nth truth set.

role: source finite subsentence set
notes: Contains A and every recursively occurring matrix; syntax has both primitive modalities.

role: source modal system as a set of theorem sentences
notes: Normality is a closure property; Sigma need not be effectively axiomatized in the general canonical lemma.

role: source theoremhood and finitely supported premise deducibility
notes: An absent premise set denotes membership in Sigma; premises use a finite theorem implication.

role: arbitrary source local premise set
notes: No global-premise necessitation; filtration uses its separately bound sentence-set role.

role: source subsentence-closed filtration sentence set
notes: May be syntactically infinite when modally closed but must be logically finite to yield a finite quotient.

role: source model worlds and canonical-world maximal theories
notes: World type is fixed by the model; canonical worlds are particular sets of sentences.

role: source truth of a sentence at a world of a standard model
notes: Classical truth clauses and both primitive modality clauses.

role: source validity throughout a class of models
notes: Truth at every world in every model; determination concerns theoremhood.

role: source local premise consequence on a model class
notes: One evaluation world satisfies every premise; not global premise truth.

role: source truth set of a sentence in a model
notes: A subset of the model world set.

role: all maximal source Sigma-consistent theories
notes: Nonempty when Sigma is consistent; the source general canonical definition and proper construction are distinguished.

role: proper source canonical accessibility relation
notes: Boxed-content containment; constructed relation rather than an assumed truth lemma.

role: exact j-step source accessibility path relation
notes: Zero is identity; exact path length not reflexive-transitive reachability.

role: source four-index modal schema
notes: Diamond-k Box-l implies Box-m Diamond-n; preserve index order and zero cases.

role: source generated restriction components
notes: Reachable world subset and restricted relation and valuation.

role: source model generated by a world
notes: All finite descendants including the root; no outgoing edge is discarded.

role: agreement on every source filtration sentence
notes: Equivalence relation on worlds in one fixed original model.

role: source quotient world and quotient image of a world set
notes: X image consists of the equivalence classes with a member in X.

role: source filtration components and quotient model
notes: Source star marks a filtration object; it is not relation reflexive-transitive closure.

role: source paired filtration constraints on two worlds
notes: c2 reverses c1; c4 reverses c3; corrected symmetric transitive construction retains all four.

role: contents of all j-times-boxed sentences in a canonical world
notes: Proof-local j-indexed set; j=0 is the world itself.

role: proof-local truth predicates for boxed and diamond sentences
notes: Used only for modalities whose sentences occur in the filtration set.

role: recursive source-to-sheet formula translation
notes: Eliminates primitive diamond through the source duality theorem and maps uppercase atoms to sheet atoms.
